errors.error_description: Used a multiplication by a constant (count_reg * 32'd3) in a continuous assignment, which can infer a costly multiplier instead of using an efficient shift/add implementation.
Assigned a 16-bit value (count_reg) to an 8-bit register (trunc_reg) without explicit casting or slicing, causing silent truncation.
Drove an input port (en) from within the module using a continuous assign, violating port directionality rules.
Declared an internal signal (floating_sig) that is never connected or used, leaving it unconnected.
